headline: Dr. Patel kept your medicines the same for now and asked for a heart ultrasound and two weeks of home blood pressure readings.

followUps.title: Arrange your heart ultrasound
followUps.detail: Book an echocardiogram to check whether your heart muscle is a little thickened. The test uses a probe and gel on your chest. There are no needles.

followUps.title: Keep a home blood pressure diary
followUps.detail: Check your blood pressure at home every morning and evening for 2 weeks. Write down all your readings.

followUps.title: Send your blood pressure diary to the office
followUps.detail: When you finish the 2 weeks of readings, mail the diary to Dr. Patel's office or ask Lisa to email it.

followUps.title: Book your follow-up with Dr. Patel
followUps.detail: Plan to see Dr. Patel in about 3 months, around March 2026. Have your heart ultrasound before this visit.
followUps.when: In about 3 months, after the echo

instructions.text: Before each blood pressure check, sit quietly for 5 minutes. Take 2 readings each time and write down both.
Choose canned soups labeled low sodium.
A piece of real black licorice now and then is fine, but not a bag a day. Large amounts can raise your blood pressure.
If your heart thumping becomes fast and irregular, or if you have chest pain or faint, call 911 or go to the emergency room.

unchanged.text: Your medicines stay the same for now. Keep taking ramipril 10 mg once a day. There are no changes to atorvastatin 20 mg at night, vitamin D 1,000 units daily, or acetaminophen for your knee.

openQuestions.text: Is your heart muscle a little thickened, as the heart tracing suggested?
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: After Dr. Patel reviews your heart ultrasound.

openQuestions.text: Will you add a second blood pressure medicine? It could be amlodipine at a lower dose or a different medicine. Dr. Patel said swelling is much less likely at a lower dose.
openQuestions.resolvesWhen: After Dr. Patel reviews your heart ultrasound and home blood pressure diary.
